description.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour — High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine. The printed weight is 650 kg and the frame is 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm.. This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying.
